title: New financing pathways for European infrastructure
summary: The report “Private Credit’s Next Act in Europe”, published by Oliver Wyman (OW), analyses market developments and the growing role of private credit in financing strategic infrastructure through asset-based finance (ABF). According to EU estimates, Europe may need to invest €3 trillion over the next five years in energy and digital infrastructure, even before accounting for defence and national security needs. Meeting this demand will require funding from across the financial system: public markets, banks, governments, and private capital. The report highlights significant opportunities for private credit to gain market share in this scenario and envisages partnerships between banks and private credit investors as a way to optimize resources.
